member.name: T:SerilogTracing.Expressions.TracingNameResolver
member.summary: Adds expression support for TimeSpan Elapsed(), bool IsSpan(), bool IsRootSpan(), TimeSpan FromUnixEpoch(DateTime), long Milliseconds(TimeSpan), long Microseconds(TimeSpan), ulong or long Nanoseconds(TimeSpan).
